instruction: Have Glitch jack into the data shard and read out the contacts stored on it.

target.reason: No offered verb lets a person read or inspect an item's contents, so 'read out the contacts stored on it' cannot be expressed. The data-shard is held by rogue, and there is no action sequence that both gets it to Glitch (rogue would have to offer it unasked) and captures the reading of its contacts; none of the end states (holding, location, or speech) represents reading a shard's data.
